segments.text: proposition 1 IT is an abſurditie to burie dead bodies in temples.
proposition 2 The ſaints which be dead are ignorant of themſelues, what is doone about their dead bodies or ſepulchres.
proposition 3 It is agréeable vnto godlineſſe for a man to chooſe himſelfe a place to be buried in.
